entry.title: feat(slam_toolbox): Add 3D web visualization and port to RDK X5
entry.content:
feat(slam_toolbox): Add 3D web visualization and port to RDK X5

新增 slam_toolbox_web_node（3D Web 可视化，端口 9992，仿 drtabmap/rtabmap_web），
并做 X5 交叉编译所需的移植裁剪。

what:
- 新增 src/slam_toolbox_web_node.cpp（boost.beast HTTP+WebSocket，订阅 /map
  /scan /odom /pose /tf /tf_static，15Hz 推 JSON + 单独帧推栅格 PNG）、
  web/index.html + web/three.min.js（three.js 3D 场景）、launch/web_launch.py；
  CMakeLists 增加 target 与 install(DIRECTORY web)。
- 移除 bond/bondcpp、G2O、OpenMP、tf2_sensor_msgs 依赖；Ceres 降级为
  LocalParameterization（板端旧版 Ceres 无 Manifold）；tf2_ros 头文件 .hpp→.h；
  karto_sdk CMP0167 加 if(POLICY) 保护、Boost_INCLUDE_DIR→Boost_INCLUDE_DIRS；
  message_filters::Subscriber 显式指定 LifecycleNode 模板参数。

why:
- 板端 3GB 内存、无 rviz/桌面，需轻量浏览器可视化看建图结果；上游依赖在 X5
  sysroot 缺失或版本不符，必须裁剪/降级才能交叉编译通过。

how:
- web 节点复用 drtabmap/rtabmap_web 的 WebServer 模式；前端轨迹/点云重建做
  节流，避免 O(N) 重建打满浏览器。

entry.title: Apply the laser mounting yaw to the interactive scan preview (#897)
entry.content:
Apply the laser mounting yaw to the interactive scan preview (#897)

While dragging a pose-graph node, processInteractiveFeedback() publishes
the node's stored scan at the dragged pose so it can be lined up against
the walls already in the map. The frame it publishes that scan in was
oriented from the node heading alone:

    q1.setEuler(0., 0., node_yaw - 3.14159);
    q2.setEuler(0., 0., 3.14159);
    quat *= q1;
    quat *= q2;

The two terms cancel, so no mount compensation is applied at all and the
preview comes out rotated by the laser's mounting yaw. That is 0 for a
laser bolted on square with the base, which is why this goes unnoticed,
but anything else is visibly wrong.

Measured on a robot whose scan_joint carries rpy="0 -${pi} 0", dragging
each node back onto its own recorded pose, with room walls at +-2.05 m:

    node 0 (at origin)      x -2.02..+2.02    outside room   0/360
    node 1 (+0.92, +0.00)   x -0.19..+3.86    outside room 113/360
    node 2 (+1.26, +0.30)   x +0.50..+4.54    outside room 172/360
    node 3 (+1.26, +1.23)   x +0.50..+4.55    outside room 165/360

After the fix all four land at +-2.02 with none outside. Node 0 looked
correct beforehand only because it sits at the centre of a square room,
where a 180 degree rotation is a symmetry.

The mounting yaw is already computed for the mapping path and handed to
karto through SetOffsetPose(), which is why the map itself is fine. Keep
it on LaserMetadata so ScanHolder, which already resolves the right laser
by the scan's frame_id, can hand the same value to the preview. That
keeps multiple lasers working: each scan gets its own laser's yaw.

Inverted lasers need no extra term: getCorrectedScan() has already
reversed the ranges, which turns the mirrored mount into this same
rotation.

merge_maps_kinematic builds LaserMetadata directly from a deserialized
dataset where no TF is available, but karto stored the mounting yaw on
the laser when the map was first built, so it is read back from there.

entry.title: Fix uninitialised read leaving upside-down lasers undetected (#894)
entry.content:
Fix uninitialised read leaving upside-down lasers undetected (#894)

* Fix upside-down laser detection reading uninitialised memory

LaserAssistant::isInverted() built a tf2::Vector3 without ever setting x
(setZ was called twice, setX never), then pushed that point through the
full mount transform:

    tf2::Vector3 laser_orient;          // x is uninitialised
    laser_orient.setY(0.);
    laser_orient.setZ(0.);
    laser_orient.setZ(1 + laser_pose_.transform.translation.z);
    laser_orient = laser_pose * laser_orient;
    if (laser_orient.z() <= 0) return true;

The result is computed as
`z = R[2][0]*x + R[2][1]*y + R[2][2]*z + t.z`, so the uninitialised x
reaches the answer whenever R[2][0] is non-zero -- and it always is:
going through the quaternion leaves ~1e-16 there rather than an exact 0.

Instrumenting the original on a robot whose scan_joint carries
rpy="0 -${pi} 0" (a 180 deg flip about Y, so the laser genuinely is
upside down), three runs out of three:

    uninitialised x   = 8.09e-320      (denormal garbage)
    R[2][0]           = 1.225e-16
    buggy z result    = nan   -> inverted = FALSE
    correct z (col 2) = -1.0  -> inverted = TRUE

The result is not a flipped sign but NaN, and every comparison against
NaN is false, so `if (z <= 0)` takes the else branch and reports the
laser upright. scanToReadings() then skips its range reversal and karto
is fed a mirrored scan. The pose graph still looks sane because odometry
constrains the matcher, so only the rasterised map is visibly wrong:
driving two laps of a 4.2 x 4.2 m room produced a 6.2 x 8.4 m /map with
~290 occupied cells outside the room. With this fix, 4.05 x 4.05 m and
none, and map->odom settles to 0.003 m / 0.2 deg instead of drifting.

Ask the rotation the question directly instead: the laser is upside down
when its own +Z axis points down in the base frame, which is the Z
component of the third column of the mount's rotation matrix. A direction
transforms by rotation only, so the translation is no longer applied, and
nothing is left uninitialised.

Reading uninitialised memory is undefined behaviour, so this can also
appear to work -- the garbage may underflow to zero on another build,
which likely explains why a symptom like this has gone unattributed for
so long (ros-perception/slam_karto#4).

* Fix out-of-bounds read and dropped beam in invertScan

    for (int i = scan.ranges.size(); i != 0; i--) {
      temp.ranges.push_back(scan.ranges[i]);

The loop starts at size(), so the first iteration reads one past the end
of the vector, and it stops at i != 0, so ranges[0] is never copied. The
output is the correct reversal shifted by one, with whatever the
out-of-bounds read returned in the first slot.

Reduced to the same loop over an exactly-sized vector, AddressSanitizer
reports it:

    ERROR: AddressSanitizer: heap-buffer-overflow
    READ of size 4 at 0x603000001c80
    0x603000001c80 is located 0 bytes after 32-byte region

    input  : 100 101 102 103 104 105 106 107
    output :   0 107 106 105 104 103 102 101      (100 is gone)

This runs for upside-down lasers on the interactive-markers path
(ScanHolder::getCorrectedScan, used while dragging a pose-graph node).
Observed on a 360-beam scan with range_min 0.1: the published
slam_toolbox/scan_visualization carried exactly one physically
impossible value, 0.0, at index 0, and none after the fix.

Note this is reachable only once isInverted() is fixed -- while it
wrongly reports every laser upright, invertScan() is never called at all.

* Drop the added commentary

entry.title: Improve slam_toolbox Windows portability (#874)
entry.content:
Improve slam_toolbox Windows portability (#874)

This upstreams the current Windows portability pieces from RoboStack patch patch/ros-rolling-slam-toolbox.win.patch.

Guard POSIX-only headers and stack-limit calls, use a portable sleep_for call, avoid GCC-only flags on MSVC, export Windows DLL symbols, define the Karto export macro while building Karto, and replace non-standard uint loop variables with unsigned int.

entry.title: CMake: fix boost system (#854)
entry.content:
CMake: fix boost system (#854)

boost system has been header only since release 1.69 (December 5, 2018), and a useless stub was provided instead.

in 1.89 (August 6, 2025), that stub was removed, so CMake fail if we require it.

ref. https://www.boost.org/doc/libs/latest/libs/system/doc/html/system.html#changes_in_boost_1_89
